description: This file defines custom Google Mock matchers and operator== overloads for specific classes used in the Rialto server project, specifically for media player context and related classes.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Overloads for comparing Rectangle and Fraction objects.

methods.name: CharStrMatcher
methods.description: A Google Mock matcher for comparing a string argument to an expected string.

methods.name: NotNullMatcher
methods.description: A Google Mock matcher that checks if a pointer argument is not null.

methods.name: arrayMatcher
methods.description: A Google Mock matcher for comparing a byte array to a vector of expected bytes.
